execution.label: List PSD layers
execution.description: Upload a local PSD to Azure Blob Storage, ask Photoshop for the document manifest, and return every layer (including those inside groups) with its name, type, id, group path and depth.

psdPath.description: Absolute path to the PSD on this machine.

psd.description: echo.document (width, height, mode), echo.layers (flat list with name, type, id, group path, depth, visible, and text for text layers), echo.names (in document order), echo.count.

steps.label: Upload the PSD and sign a read URL

value.$expr: (state) => { const out = []; const walk = (layers, parents) => { for (const layer of layers || []) { const row = { name: layer.name, type: layer.type, id: layer.id, path: [...parents, layer.name].join(' / '), depth: parents.length, visible: layer.visible }; if (layer.text && typeof layer.text.content === 'string') row.text = layer.text.content; out.push(row); if (Array.isArray(layer.children)) walk(layer.children, [...parents, layer.name]); } }; const first = ((state.manifest && state.manifest.outputs) || [])[0] || {}; const content = first.destination && first.destination.content; walk(first.layers || (content && content.layers), []); return { document: content && content.document ? { width: content.document.bounds.right - content.document.bounds.left, height: content.document.bounds.bottom - content.document.bounds.top, mode: content.document.imageMode } : undefined, layers: out, names: out.map((layer) => layer.name), count: out.length }; }
